result.keyword: What's the best help desk software for a small support team?
result.markdown:
For most small support teams, I would recommend **Freshdesk or Help Scout**\. They offer the best balance of ease of use, ticket management, automation, and affordability without the complexity of enterprise platforms.

However, the best choice depends on whether your team primarily handles email, live chat, or multiple support channels.

## My top 6 help desk recommendations

![Freshdesk 2026 Pricing, Features, Reviews & Alternatives | GetApp](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/klgxLc6NG8otUkH5AhduDPmXh8oQ43gFOBiP3t1zhdAaloxdkR5830S_fNTvUdrNn8F85zVJ5QZ9e-I1iaqVhiORGKnim7mB_ZM6LSWZNqe_pVC6M2wvo9oLrAEALeSwpIJMNpfqWv-XV2mHYcEg2Ds7L-ap5ShDhjUls1NiWz6hkaOiszd_AyIs1nCNQ6dg?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Freshdesk**

(Best overall)

From approximately \$19/agent/month

- Excellent ticket management
- Automation and routing
- Knowledge base and reporting
- Good room to grow as your team expands

Best for: Small teams wanting a traditional, full-featured help desk.

[Freshdesk website](https://www.freshworks.com/freshdesk/)

---

![Live Product Walkthrough | Help Scout](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NnHqiJ-3KMDAeHBXrXZgveYXqx8g7pMW0U40CpizvFRpWVOLTddA42cFW8OCNeBaGh0H7euKNcqHwvhQDUv8Lg0jI8uq5SvDwaybcrRUMK6tW5rTHK_ERD4ErvEf3CJpK7o00ilfRn38bpY1y1Wmhy5bcad5bKMOGluHlAJ312ulJXQsMDdpAERcCzJYdBgB?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Help Scout**

(Best for small teams)

Free plan; paid from approximately \$25/user/month

- Very intuitive shared inbox
- Customer conversation history
- Knowledge base
- Easy collaboration between agents

Best for: Email-first teams that value simplicity and customer experience.

[Help Scout website](https://www.helpscout.com/)

---

![Planning your knowledge base](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/c-aP08cOYxkyyv9X77vAO6BTznUrnbcE682O_PNXv85rTzeJ7P8rfPi0zwEy5RuJoItPtTqoOS_qx_th3WBRO5qW1_R1PEH6lnQv9fjQNK8k9Lq0ZpXaKAQ9c430TCrqKQIQ-l-YOuE_UJtZkcQj3vAw0fnqYwhILulvnKb-85lypWsGsBgNPmp7t1d2mt9a?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho Desk**

(Best budget option)

Free plan; paid from approximately \$9/agent/month

- Affordable ticketing
- Workflow automation
- Strong reporting
- Excellent Zoho CRM integration

Best for: Budget-conscious teams that need structured support workflows.

[Zoho Desk website](https://www.zoho.com/desk/)

---



**4\. Zendesk**

Suite plans from approximately \$55/agent/month

- Powerful ticketing and workflows
- Extensive integrations
- Omnichannel customer support
- Advanced analytics

Best for: Teams expecting significant growth or complex support requirements.

[Zendesk website](https://www.zendesk.com/)

---

![AI-powered customer service software | Intercom | Intercom](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/-x24P6TNjEPvea-VsNe0jnZTT3eXHI9IdYAiZRYLVjrngnT0ZjPOl1-ZDb8tbH_uppxEj-RIowPtFF1-6cnYOLWMA9tsYQ7iLhvT7SWZDWkna7cpNybO5shHV-birMoVjjOQzsOWLBpFhRavPj7gKu0o27xQApt17sM6PrV_01c0NY5T7d1gvUnRocTlpU8F?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Intercom**

Pricing varies by plan and usage

- Excellent live chat
- AI customer service agent
- Automated conversations
- In-app messaging

Best for: SaaS businesses and teams with chat-heavy support.

[Intercom website](https://www.intercom.com/)

---

![LiveAgent | AppSumo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/3Um1Tu9x8CBTOsu6P79VE23wi8OMKZHJIW3hTJV3ywA1fHmmFwD6pP0FxjWc_23jTB0mPdb_v3huy9sJBwoygDn1djabU34YBhD1dlwZDiUW-nhedAKdK9j1x8ZkfQWZfvYs_3Yf_4JujRA3wHrtQCuShPh3dQuhnlUB_yq2guBIlgjeYicT0jJ2_l69zOf2?purpose=fullsize)

**6\. LiveAgent**

From approximately \$15/agent/month

- Email, phone, chat and social support
- Unified customer communication
- Ticket assignment and automation

Best for: Teams supporting customers across several communication channels.

[LiveAgent website](https://www.liveagent.com/)

Pricing is indicative, generally based on annual billing, and can vary by plan, region and add-ons. ## Quick comparison

| Software | Ease of use | Best strength |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Freshdesk | Very good | Ticket management |
| Help Scout | Excellent | Shared inbox |
| Zoho Desk | Good | Affordability |
| Zendesk | Good | Advanced workflows |
| Intercom | Very good | AI and live chat |
| LiveAgent | Good | Multiple channels |


## What I would choose

My recommendation\:

- **2–5 agents\:** Help Scout
- **5–15 agents\:** Freshdesk
- **Very tight budget\:** Zoho Desk
- **SaaS or technology company\:** Intercom
- **Complex, multichannel support\:** Zendesk
